games:2026-wk13-usc-ucla.blurb: USC is a 7-point favorite on the road, but ESPN's model can't separate these rivals at all, giving UCLA a 51.2% edge in a game with a 45.5 total. The No. 10 Bruins are the Big Ten's current leader; the No. 15 Trojans are chasing from the bubble's back edge.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-purdue-indiana.blurb: No. 12 Indiana is a 22.5-point home favorite over Purdue with a 94.9% win probability. The Hoosiers are the closest chaser in the Big Ten race, so style points are the only real question.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-georgia-tech-g.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 35.5-point home favorite over Georgia Tech, with ESPN giving the Bulldogs a 98.3% win probability. Clean Old-Fashioned Hate projects as a formality on paper.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-boston-college.blurb: No. 4 Miami is a 25.5-point home favorite over Boston College with a 97.9% win probability. The Hurricanes lead the ACC race and should treat this as a tune-up.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA slid from fourth to 10th and still sits as the Big Ten's leader, with SP+ at 12th and FPI down at 22nd. The models have never been as sold as the poll was.

predictions:indiana.blurb: Indiana dropped from eighth to 12th despite ranking fifth in SP+ and eighth in FPI. The Hoosiers grade out as a better team than their new slot suggests.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 10 UCLA leads with No. 12 Indiana just two spots back. One bad Saturday flips it.

bubbleNotes:indiana.blurb: Indiana is the first team out at No. 13, just one spot from the field, but the Hoosiers fell four places in the latest look. They're closest to in and moving backward at the same time.

bubbleNotes:usc.blurb: USC climbed three spots to the 16 seed, still four out of the field, and draws No. 10 UCLA next. Win that and the math changes in a hurry.

games:2026-wk13-michigan-ohio-state.blurb: The Game returns with No. 25 Ohio State laying 10 at home and ESPN's model giving the Buckeyes an 89% shot. A 38.5 total says points will be hard to come by, which is exactly how Michigan would want to steal one.

games:2026-wk13-arizona-state-arizona.blurb: No. 16 Arizona hosts the Territorial Cup as an 8.5-point favorite with a 78% win probability, and a 54.5 total hints neither defense is shutting the door. Arizona State arrives as the underdog with a chance to wreck a ranked season.

games:2026-wk13-louisville-kentucky.blurb: No. 18 Louisville goes to Lexington favored by just a field goal, with ESPN giving the Cardinals a 64% edge. The Governor's Cup sets up as a coin-flip-adjacent shootout at 54.5, and a slip here costs Louisville real ranking equity.

games:2026-wk13-oklahoma-missouri.blurb: The most evenly matched game on the board: No. 24 Missouri is a 1.5-point home favorite over No. 19 Oklahoma, and ESPN's model splits it 50.3 to 49.6. With a 41.5 total, expect a grinder where one possession decides which ranked team keeps climbing.

games:2026-wk13-florida-florida-state.blurb: No. 20 Florida travels to Tallahassee a 6-point favorite with a 66% win probability in a rivalry game the Seminoles can use to salvage their season. The 52.5 total suggests the Gators will have to keep scoring to hold serve.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-baylor-houston.blurb: No. 17 Houston hosts Baylor as a 5.5-point favorite, with ESPN's model landing at a modest 59%. A 55.5 total points to a track meet, and the Cougars need it to keep their recent climb going.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-texas-texas-a-.blurb: No. 5 Texas heads to College Station favored by 11.5 with an 84% win probability, but the 40.5 total says this rivalry stays low-scoring. The Longhorns can't afford a stumble with their place near the top of the SEC picture on the line.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-nebraska-iowa.blurb: No. 13 Iowa is a 4.5-point home favorite over Nebraska with just a 59% edge from ESPN's model. A 40.5 total fits the matchup, and every possession matters for an Iowa team hovering right outside the playoff field.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-auburn-alabama.blurb: No. 6 Alabama lays 16.5 in the Iron Bowl and carries an 88% win probability at home. Auburn's path is simple and steep: slow the game down and make the Tide earn every yard under that 48.5 total.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-cincinnati-byu.blurb: No. 11 BYU hosts Cincinnati as a 15.5-point favorite with an 88% shot per ESPN. The 55.5 total suggests the Cougars will try to win it with pace rather than a rock fight.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-mississippi-st.blurb: No. 23 Ole Miss is favored by 18.5 in the Egg Bowl with an 88% win probability at home. The 56.5 total is the highest on the SEC slate, so Mississippi State's best hope is keeping it a scoring contest.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-washington-ore.blurb: No. 14 Oregon hosts Washington as a 14-point favorite and an 87% pick by ESPN's model. The Ducks are sitting on the playoff bubble, so style points here are worth something beyond the win column.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-tcu-texas-tech.blurb: No. 9 Texas Tech opens the weekend at home favored by 13.5 over TCU, with an 82% win probability. The Red Raiders are chasing Utah in the Big 12 and can't let this one get interesting.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-tennessee-vand.blurb: No. 7 Tennessee visits Vanderbilt as a 13.5-point favorite with an 88% edge in ESPN's model. The 43.5 total suggests the Commodores will try to shorten the game and keep it within reach.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-west-virginia-.blurb: No. 2 Utah is a 22.5-point home favorite over West Virginia at a 94% win probability, with a 68.5 total that's the highest on the slate. The Utes have the Big 12's automatic bid in their grip and nothing to gain from a sloppy afternoon.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-notre-dame-syr.blurb: No. 3 Notre Dame is a 24.5-point favorite at Syracuse with a 95% win probability. Anything other than a comfortable Irish afternoon would be the story of the weekend.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-liberty-missou.blurb: No. 21 Liberty is favored by 15.5 at Missouri State with ESPN giving the Flames a 90% shot. A 52.5 total and an overmatched host mean the only real question is the margin.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-duke-wake-fore.blurb: No. 8 Wake Forest hosts Duke laying 14.5 with a 78% win probability. The Demon Deacons are chasing Miami in the ACC, so a tidy win keeps the pressure on.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk13-boise-state-co.blurb: No. 22 Boise State is a 21-point favorite at Colorado State with a 95% win probability and a gaudy 76.5 total. Points should be everywhere; the Broncos just need to pile up more of them.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State tumbled from 14th to 25th in the poll, but the advanced numbers haven't blinked: SP+ has the Buckeyes fourth and FPI sixth. That gap is the widest on the board, and a win in The Game would start closing it.

predictions:houston.blurb: Houston climbed from 20th to 17th, though the models remain skeptical with SP+ at 25 and FPI at 29. Beating Baylor at home is the kind of result that keeps the poll and the metrics from drifting further apart.

predictions:florida.blurb: Florida jumped from 24th to 20th, and FPI largely buys it at 21 while SP+ lags way behind at 47. A road win over Florida State would give the poll voters more to work with than the efficiency numbers currently offer.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia holds the SEC's automatic bid at No. 1 with No. 5 Texas four spots back -- close enough that one Bulldog slip flips the league's playoff pecking order.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: Miami sits atop the ACC at No. 4 with No. 8 Wake Forest four spots behind, so the Demon Deacons remain squarely in range of the league's automatic bid.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah has built the most comfortable cushion of any league leader, sitting at No. 2 with No. 9 Texas Tech seven spots back in the Big 12 chase. The Red Raiders need help as much as they need wins.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon slipped a spot to the 15 seed and now sits three places outside the field, which makes the home date with Washington a must-win rather than a tune-up.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa moved up two spots to the 14 seed and is just two places from the field, with Nebraska visiting next in a game the Hawkeyes are only a modest favorite to win.
